name: CR-104 Demo: SEU commence-work sign-off
description: CR-104 validation fixture — an SEU-scoped Policy governing the SEU's own Activated -> Operational transition (the platform's own commence-work sign-off step), not any owned Deliverable/AttentionItem. Its own governingCondition is deliberately always-unsatisfied so adopting this Definition demonstrably blocks that hop, proving the mechanism end to end.

conditions.statement: The SEU has a recorded commence-work sign-off before becoming Operational.

relatedObligations.title: Record the SEU's commence-work sign-off
relatedObligations.description: This SEU may not become Operational until a commence-work sign-off (client sign-off, active contract, manager approval — whichever this Profile requires) is recorded against it.
relatedObligations.completionCriteria: A commence-work sign-off is recorded for this SEU, and this Policy's own condition is re-evaluated true.

requiredEvidence.title: Commence-work sign-off record
requiredEvidence.description: A recorded sign-off (client approval, contract execution, or manager approval) authorizing this SEU to begin Operational work.
requiredEvidence.collectionMethod: Manual attestation recorded by the responsible Authority holder.
